For the Petitioners : Mr. Piyush Kumar Roy, Advocate For the State : Mr. Bishwambhar Shastri,

By the Court:-
1. Heard the parties.

2. This criminal miscellaneous petition has been filed invoking the jurisdiction of this Court under Section 528 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 with a prayer to quash and set aside the entire criminal proceeding against the petitioners in connection with Telaiya P.S. Case No. 129 of 2018 (corresponding to G.R. Case No.
Chandan Kumar Rai @ Chandan Rai vs The State Of Jharkhand on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113453304/
1 526 of 2018) including the order taking cognizance dated 02.03.2022, passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, ( 2025:JHHC:20927 ) Koderma whereby and where under the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate has taken cognizance of the offences punishable under Section 498A/323/504/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act inter-alia against the petitioners.

entities.text: Chandan Kumar Rai @ Chandan Rai vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. The brief fact of the case is that the petitioner no.1 being the brother-in-law (Devar) and the petitioner no.2 being the Chachi Saas (paternal aunt of the husband) and relative of the husband of the informant treated the informant with cruelty and demanded dowry.
There is specific allegation against the petitioners that inter-alia the petitioners after the marriage of the informant demanded dowry of a four wheeler Swift Dzire Car and a gold chain.

As the informant and her parents could not meet the said dowry demand, inter-alia the petitioners treated the informant with cruelty, both mentally and physically along with the co- accused persons taking all the gold and silver jewelleries of the informant and her sarees and wearing apparels also, to harass her.
The petitioners imposed the condition of the fulfilment of the said dowry demand of Swift Dzire Car as a condition precedent for allowing the informant to stay in her matrimonial house.
On 01.01.2015, the petitioners along with the co-accused persons assaulted the informant and exhorted the husband of the informant to kill the informant by causing an accident.

The petitioners along with the co-accused persons were treating the informant as a servant and also attempted to kill her by burning ( 2025:JHHC:20927 )
her.
The petitioners called the informant an ominous woman; consequent upon the death of a pet dog in the matrimonial house of the informant.

On 06.11.2015, after the death of the mother-in- law of the informant, the petitioners abused the informant by using filthy language and told the parents of the informant to take the informant back to their house and to send the informant to her matrimonial house only after meeting the dowry demand of the Swift Dzire Car.
On 14.11.2016, the petitioners assaulted the informant and pressurized her to sign a paper.

On 17.11.2016 on the eve of the marriage of the younger brother of the husband of the informant, the petitioners and others ill-treated the parents of the informant and again set the condition of giving the Swift Dzire Car for the informant to be admitted in her matrimonial house.

The petitioners and others also told the parents of the informant that they will get the marriage of the husband of the informant solemnized for the second time with someone else than the informant and deserted the informant forcing her to go with her parents to her paternal house.

On 06.05.2018, the petitioners went to the paternal house of the informant and told that as the informant and her parents are not meeting the dowry demand of Swift Dzire Car, hence they will get the marriage of the informant with her husband dissolved and get a second marriage of the husband of the informant solemnized with someone else and also abused the informant and her parents.
4. On the basis of the written report submitted by the informant, police registered Telaiya P.S. Case No. 129 of 2018 and took up investigation of the case and after completion of the investigation,
police
submitted charge sheet against the petitioners and the learned Magistrate has taken cognizance of the offence as already indicated above.

sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the petitioners relies upon the Judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of K. Subba Rao & Ors. Vs. The State of Telangana, Rep. by its Secretary,
Department of Home and Ors., in Criminal Appeal No. 1045 of 2018 dated 21.08.2018 wherein the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India relied upon its own Judgment in the case of Kans Raj Vs. State of Punjab & Ors., reported in (2000) 5 SCC 207 wherein it was observed that the Courts should be careful in proceeding against the distant relatives in crimes pertaining to matrimonial disputes and dowry deaths.

entities.text: K. Subba Rao & Ors. Vs. The State of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Kans Raj Vs. State of Punjab & Ors., reported in (2000) 5 SCC 207
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The learned counsel for the petitioners next relies upon the Judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of Shlok Bhardwaj Vs. Runika Bhardwaj & Ors., in Criminal Appeal No. 741 of 2009 dated 10.12.2014, wherein in the facts of that case, when the matter was before the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in connection with a Transfer Petition and the Hon'ble Supreme Court noted that since both the parties have sought divorce, the marriage has broken down and the parties have agreed to a decree of divorce by mutual consent and thereafter Family Court,
Jabalpur, passed a ( 2025:JHHC:20927 ) decree of divorce, it was observed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India that the High Court has not adverted to the development of settlement between the parties.

entities.text: Shlok Bhardwaj Vs. Runika Bhardwaj & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Though, it was not expressly recorded in the order of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in that case but once the matter was settled between the parties and the settlement has been given effect to in the form of divorce by mutual consent, the further dispute in that case did not suffice between the parties and submits that in this case also divorce having been taken place in terms of Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act, so on that sole ground, the prayer as prayed for by the petitioners be allowed.

6. The learned counsel for the petitioners next relies upon the Judgment of this Court in the case of Krishna Murari @ Krishna Murari Prasad & Anr. Vs. The State of Jharkhand & Anr., reported in 2025:JHHC:11966,

entities.text: Krishna Murari @ Krishna Murari Prasad & Anr. Vs. The State of Jharkhand & Anr., reported in 2025:JHHC:11966,
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
wherein in the facts of that case where the only allegation against the accused person -petitioner no.2 in that case was that she told the victim of that case to do as her son is telling her to do and on one occasion, she told the informant of that case to go away, so that the son of the accused can bring a doctor wife and police submitted a final form finding the allegation against the accused person of the case to be not true, this Court held that such allegation against an accused person is insufficient for the learned A.C.J.M. in that case to have differed from the charge sheet by which the petitioner no.2 was not sent up for trial and quashed the entire criminal proceeding against the ( 2025:JHHC:20927 ) petitioner no.2 of that case only and submits that in this case also,
the allegations made against the petitioners are general and omnibus, hence they do not warrant prosecution.
It is, therefore, submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the prayer as prayed for by the petitioners in this criminal miscellaneous petition be allowed.

7. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor on the other hand vehemently opposes the prayer as prayed for by the petitioners in this criminal miscellaneous petition and submits that unlike the case of Krishna Murari @ Krishna Murari Prasad & Anr. Vs. The State of Jharkhand & Anr. (supra), this is not a case where the allegations against the petitioners are general and omnibus, rather this is a case where the allegation of treating the informant with cruelty and demanding dowry of a Swift Dzire Car is direct and specific against the petitioners and the petitioners on several occasions have demanded the dowry and put pressure upon the informant and harassed her to meet the dowry demand.

entities.text: Krishna Murari @ Krishna Murari Prasad & Anr. Vs. The State of Jharkhand & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hence, it is submitted that this is not a fit case where the prayer as prayed for by the petitioners in this criminal miscellaneous petition be allowed.

It is next submitted by the learned Chandan Kumar Rai @ Chandan Rai vs The State Of Jharkhand on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113453304/
3 Addl. P.P.

entities.text: Chandan Kumar Rai @ Chandan Rai vs The State Of Jharkhand on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: that the undisputed fact remains that the father-in-law and mother-in-law of the informant are not alive and the petitioners taking an active role in the demand of dowry and consequent harassment and treatment with cruelty meted out by them to the informant for meeting the dowry demand.

Hence, it is submitted that as all the ( 2025:JHHC:20927 ) offences in respect of which cognizance has been taken by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Koderma, consequent upon submission of charge sheet against the petitioners for having committed the said offences,
therefore, this criminal miscellaneous petition being without any merit be dismissed.

8. Having heard the submissions made at the Bar and after going through the materials available in the record, it is pertinent to mention here that it is a settled principle of law as has been held by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of State of M.P. vs. Awadh Kishore Gupta & Others reported in (2004) 1 SCC 691 that the defence of the accused persons and the veracity of the evidence put forth by the accused persons cannot be considered in exercise of the jurisdiction under Section 482 Cr.P.C. by the High Court as that would be the job of the trial court.

entities.text: State of M.P. vs. Awadh Kishore Gupta & Others reported in (2004) 1 SCC 691
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
9. It is also a settled principle of law as has been held by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of Monica Kumar (Dr.) and another v. State of U.P. and others, reported in (2008) 8 SCC 781 that the genuine prosecution cannot be stifled in exercise of the power under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C.
10.

entities.text: Monica Kumar (Dr.) and another v. State of U.P. and others, reported in (2008) 8 SCC 781
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is also a settled principle of law as has been reiterated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India,
in the case of State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr. vs. Akhil Sharda & Ors. reported in 2022 LiveLaw SC 594 the settled principle of law that no mini trial can be conducted by the high court in exercise of power under Section 482 Cr.P.C, the relevant portion of which reads as under :-
( 2025:JHHC:20927 ) " Having gone through the impugned judgment and order passed by the High court has set aside the criminal proceedings in exercise of powers under Section 482 CrPC, it appears that the High Court has virtually conducted a mini trial, which as such is not permissible at this stage and while deciding the application under Section 482CrPC.

entities.text: State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr. vs. Akhil Sharda & Ors. reported in 2022 LiveLaw SC 594
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As observed and held by this court in a catena of decisions, no mini trial can be conducted by the High Court in exercise of power under Section 482CrPC, jurisdiction and at the stage of deciding the application under Section 482CrPC, the High Court cannot get into appreciation of evidence of the particular case being considering.
(Emphasis supplied)"

11. Now coming to the facts of the case, as already indicated above, there is direct and specific allegation against the petitioners with specific date of treating the informant with cruelty and harassing her with a view to coerce the informant and her parents to meet the unlawful demand of the Swift Dzire Car.

Under such circumstances, this Court is of the considered view that in view of the direct allegation of serious nature against the petitioners, this Court is of the considered view that this is not a fit case where the entire criminal proceeding in connection with Telaiya P.S. Case No. 129 of 2018 (corresponding to G.R. Case No. 526 of 2018) including the order taking cognizance dated 02.03.2022, passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Chandan Kumar Rai @ Chandan Rai vs The State Of Jharkhand on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113453304/
4

entities.text: Chandan Kumar Rai @ Chandan Rai vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Koderma be quashed and set aside at this nascent stage.
12. Accordingly, this criminal miscellaneous petition being without any merit is dismissed.
